name: MSP_REBOOT

payload_layout.note: In: request carries an OPTIONAL u8 reboot_mode; an empty request selects the normal firmware reboot (mode value 0). Reply echoes the accepted u8 mode. The board reboots AFTER the reply is sent; the reply is NOT proof the board returned. src/main/msp/msp.c lines 2322-2337 and reboot-mode enum 163-168 (blob 804d1dd3c9ee55cb0995f92352bac6d50911c671) @4.5.5.

verification.method: Encoded/decoded by ade-protocol-msp round-trip tests built from the same pinned records. MOCK_EXERCISED checks our codec's internal consistency only; it is not independent evidence about hardware.

licensing.note: Numeric interface constant read from a published pinned source and restated. No code, comments, tables, fixtures or error strings were copied.

notes: Correction: earlier planning documents used the non-existent name MSP_SET_REBOOT. Reboot semantics and any mode argument are NOT recorded and must not be assumed.
